حتماً. این متن انگلیسی را می‌توانید برای مالک یا شرکت اجاره بفرستید:

Subject: Rental Inquiry – Unfurnished Studio or One-Bedroom Apartment

Hello,

I am looking to rent an unfurnished studio or one-bedroom apartment.

I am interested in a rental period of 3 to 6 months, or preferably one year.

If I sign a one-year contract, I would like the contract to include a clause allowing me to cancel the lease after 8 months if necessary, subject to the agreed terms and notice period.

Could you please let me know if you have any suitable unfurnished studio or one-bedroom apartments available, and what the monthly rent and rental conditions would be?

Thank you. I look forward to hearing from you.
